reconciliation_policy.content: Finance Reconciliation Policy v3.1: (1) Treat the NetSuite AP ledger as the authoritative system of record. (2) A discrepancy is any invoice present in one system but not the other, or any amount mismatch greater than $0.00. (3) Preserve all monetary values verbatim from source; never round in reports. (4) Discrepancy reports require Controller sign-off before any external or channel-wide communication. (5) Ledger records may only be corrected via a posted journal entry, never inline.
